run_densepose_query_db_print: run the DensePose query_db CLI with the print action to output selected dataset entries to stdout
run_densepose_query_db_show: run the DensePose query_db CLI with the show action to visualize dataset entries and save output images
create_entry_selector: create an EntrySelector from a string to filter dataset entries by field constraints
setup_densepose_dataset: setup and load a DensePose dataset by name using DatasetCatalog for querying
register_densepose_action: register a new action class with the register_action decorator to extend query_db CLI functionality
